recognize_zh: 普魯士藍鐵染色下，許多有核紅血球的細胞核周圍環繞著藍色含鐵顆粒，形成完整或部分的環狀排列，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules encircling the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Granules arranged in a perinuclear ring covering a third or more of the nuclear circumference
Nuclei and cytoplasm counterstained pink with nuclear red/safranin
Clusters of ring sideroblasts within an erythroid-rich area
Background refractile red cells; scattered iron granules outside cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue shows numerous erythroid precursors containing coarse blue iron-positive granules arranged in a perinuclear ring pattern, consistent with ring sideroblasts. The ring sideroblasts are clustered and constitute a substantial proportion of the erythroid cells in this field. In a patient with thrombocytosis, these findings are consistent with the ring sideroblast component of myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis (formerly RARS-T); SF3B1 and JAK2 testing and correlation with megakaryocytic morphology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only a few fine scattered granules, not coarse granules encircling one-third or more of the nucleus.

ddx.dx: MDS with SF3B1 mutation / ring sideroblasts
ddx.vs: MDS with ring sideroblasts lacks the persistent thrombocytosis (≥450 x 10^9/L) and MPN-like large megakaryocytes of MDS/MPN-RS-T.

ddx.dx: Secondary sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, isoniazid, lead)
ddx.vs: Acquired secondary causes resolve with removal of the toxin or copper repletion and lack SF3B1 or other clonal mutations.
Congenital forms present early with microcytic anemia and germline mutations, without thrombocytosis or clonal myeloid features.
